forbiddenInformation: opponent private hand before public reveal
deck order or unrevealed deck contents
physical game RNG or shuffle seed
raw Twinleaf engine state outside the validated actor projection
other role process memory or private files
observationBoundary.caveat: The policy module is actor-view-only by source inspection and protocol fixture tests, but the worker and runner share a Node process; this is not a process-isolation or security-sandbox proof.

determinism.repeatedRequestInvariant: same request/config/seat yields the same decision
determinism.physicalSeedAccess: not present in the policy API; the actual Agent49 request validator rejects undeclared seed/private fields

roleAndSeat.testCoverage: synthetic actor fixtures exercise seat 0 and seat 1; no game-level seat coverage

decisionBoundary.unsupportedPromptBehavior: abstain with a stable reason code; no delegated decoder or native fallback
decisionBoundary.rootFallback: select pass only when an actual pass token exists in the action frontier; otherwise abstain
decisionBoundary.selectionValidation: actual Agent49 validateDecision enforces prompt choice tokens, uniqueness, selection bounds, cancel and empty-selection semantics
cardSpecificBehavior: Palace Book SMP NAN25 is treated as a no-prompt draw-three/end-turn Item; policy score is deliberately minimal and only considered with hand size <=2, deck count >=4, and Item lock cleared.
Faba -> Jet Energy -> Active Wobbuffet -> Nest Ball is gated by public Hood, Power of Alchemy, Temple of Sinnoh, hand, Bench-space and turn-resource state.

runtime.localHarness: GitHub Actions Node 22 node:test; actual repository worker validators and policy module are imported

sharedConstraints.testSplit: development fixtures only; held-out review cases are separately listed and unexecuted
sharedConstraints.workerInitConfig: empty object; source and candidate fingerprints are immutable policy/suite bindings, not IPC config
